value.body: The Indian Statistical Institute (ISI), an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation, runs two-year master's programmes in statistics (M.Stat) and mathematics (M.Math). Both are theory-heavy, with a large coursework load and project work.

items.label: M.Stat stipend
items.note: Subject to the institute's performance rules

items.label: Selection
items.note: Direct admission for eligible ISI graduates

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Graduates of ISI's B.Stat or B.Math can move on directly if they meet the institute's conditions. Others need a bachelor's degree with the mathematics or statistics background set in the prospectus, then ISI's admission test and an interview.

value.title: At a glance
items: Common outcomes are quantitative finance, data science, actuarial work, government statistics and Ph.D. programmes in India and abroad.
Stipends are tied to academic performance under the institute's rules.
Rules on eligibility, campuses and stipends are set in each year's prospectus.
